subject: Electrical Engineering
title: The PN Junction: Where N Meets P
description: A micro-lesson that makes The PN Junction: Where N Meets P usable.

hook.text: Press N-type silicon against P-type and something magical happens at the boundary.

buildup.text: Electrons from N drift into P. Holes from P drift into N. They cancel each other out.

discovery.text: A depletion zone forms — a thin region empty of free carriers, creating a built-in voltage.

twist.text: This barrier blocks further diffusion. The junction reaches equilibrium on its own.

climax.text: The PN junction is the foundation of diodes, LEDs, solar cells, and transistors.

punchline.text: Where N meets P, a barrier rises — and all of electronics is born.

quiz.question: What forms at the boundary of a PN junction?
options: A depletion zone with no free carriers and a built-in voltage
A thin metallic layer that connects the two sides
